summary: Company badges in Business Central give each company a visual identifier, which helps when working across several companies and environments. The video shows how to set badge style, color and text (up to six characters) in Company Information, and that badge shape shows environment type: round for production, square for sandbox.
overview:
The video, about two minutes long, shows why a visual identifier helps when you work with multiple companies and environments. The presenter has four environments, some with several companies, and uses badges to tell them apart.

It then goes to the Company Information page and shows how to set the badge style and text and choose different colors. It also explains that the badge shape reflects the environment type.
key_points: Company badges visually identify a company, which is useful with multiple companies and environments.
Badge shape shows environment type: round for production, square for sandbox.
Badge text can be up to six characters.
Badge colors and text can be set per company to tell companies and environments apart.
Badge settings are configured on the Company Information page, including whether the badge is custom and which style it uses.
